title: Implement Request Body Parsing
description: This feature is crucial for handling HTTP requests with JSON payloads, enabling the framework to parse and make the request body available to route handlers. It improves performance by reducing the need for manual parsing and solves real problems by providing a standardized way of accessing request data. This feature will enhance the overall usability of the framework
acceptance: Request body is correctly parsed and available to route handlers for JSON and URL-encoded payloads, with proper error handling for invalid payloads
reason: This feature is essential for building robust and scalable applications, and its implementation aligns with the framework's focus on feature-driven development and high-quality code
